summary: Ituran Location & Control furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 9, 2026, announcing its award of a first multi-year SaaS contract with entities under the Israeli Ministry of Transport. The contract runs up to four years and is valued at over NIS 21 million (roughly US$7 million), with the first year, NIS 5 million (about US$1.7 million), guaranteed. The Big Data traffic-monitoring platform draws on anonymized data from more than one million vehicles. This is an ordinary commercial contract win, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
